# Private banking corpus

Redistribution rights are not established. No source files are committed here. The user authorized local analysis of four supplied files; this does not authorize redistribution. Configure `LAIP_BANKING_FIXTURE_DIR` to a private directory containing the exact originals. Missing fixtures skip private pytest cases; hash differences fail closed, never normalize bytes. The standalone harness requires all originals.

`manifest.json` freezes SHA-256, byte and physical-line counts. `oracle.json` is authored from source and the plan's cited IBM semantics rather than analyzer output. UPLOAD libraries, namespace, source/object associations and collection timestamp are test-only assumptions. They do not prove compiled or live identities.

The original omission assertions now run without expected-failure markers. Clock functions remain symbolic; original 83-column display line 26 remains malformed under the strict profile. Source text is not emitted by the harness or included in its exports. The readonly oracle checks share one immutable snapshot per module; stateful recovery and cancellation checks use separate disposable schemas.
